parts.name: Root
parts.description: The toggle button. Renders a native <button type="button"> with aria-pressed and exposes selected and interaction state through data attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: Stable identifier forwarded to the button. Required for selection when composed inside `ToggleGroup.Root`; does not represent the selected state.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selected state when uncontrolled. Ignored inside a `ToggleGroup`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state. Bindable. `undefined` syncs as `false` in controlled usage. Ignored inside a `ToggleGroup`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the user changes the selected state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes the toggle from interaction and focus order.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content. Optionally receives the current render state (e.g. `selected`) as a snippet parameter.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-grouped
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is rendered inside a `ToggleGroup.Root`.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the toggle.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is actively pressed via pointer or keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-unselected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is not selected.
